core_meaning.primary_meaning: Anees is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Friendly, companion, intimate friend”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Anees corresponds to the Arabic form أنيس (Arabic root أ ن س (ʾ-n-s); أَنِيس (ʾanīs)). Its core sense is friendly, companion; intimate friend.
